Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, back out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. If you get a Calibrum mark, retreat immediately: he can follow up with an attack from beyond his normal range. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil deals more damage the more champions it hits, so spread out from your allies.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals primarily physical damage, so prioritize armor if you build defenses. If the enemy team has a lot of healing or fights with Aphelios run long, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Aphelios.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. Watch Aphelios's weapons and look for windows when his burst damage is low.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first and keep Aphelios under his turret, gaining a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks. If you get a Calibrum mark, focus on preserving health instead of further harass.
Aphelios.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Aphelios will retreat. If it catches him, follow the empowered attack from Caitlyn P Headshot with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Aphelios.escape: Go in after the threat of Gravitum's slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites's root has passed.
Aphelios.phase: Early game is a good time for Caitlyn to gain an advantage through range pressure. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. In late game, do not count on Caitlyn having a raw damage advantage; attack safely from the edge of your range.
Aphelios.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. Use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole when you have a clear path that prevents another enemy from taking the shot instead.

Ashe.watch: Move sideways to dodge the area slow from Ashe W Volley. The slow from Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes with each basic attack, so do not stay within Ashe's attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, do not start a skirmish from outside vision; change direction as you move to dodge the arrow. Create distance when Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active.
Ashe.fight: Trade only when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, and create distance immediately after attacking. Look for an opening after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended.
Ashe.laning: Early on, use Caitlyn's range advantage to push the wave first and keep Ashe under her turret, gaining a CS and Turret Plating lead. Charge Caitlyn P Headshot in the brush and use it on Ashe. After pushing the wave, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance. Take a short trade only right after Ashe W Volley is used.
Ashe.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Ashe will retreat. If it catches her, use an empowered attack followed by Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Use Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker when no minions are in its path.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability, so go in during a window after Ashe W Volley is used, when Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow cannot catch you.
Ashe.phase: Early game is a good time to pressure Ashe with Caitlyn's range advantage and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives. In late game, do not stand close relying on raw damage alone; attack safely from the edge of your range.
Ashe.teamfight: Attack from the edge of your maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. Another enemy can take Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole instead, so do not use it during a chaotic fight.

Draven.watch: Avoid trades while Draven maintains two Draven Q Spinning Axe axes. He can approach with the movement and attack speed from Draven W Blood Rush, and Draven E Stand Aside can knock you aside or slow you. Draven R Whirling Death can hit you on its return path, so even after dodging the first hit, move completely out of its round-trip path.
Draven.build: Prioritize armor against Draven's main damage. Watch your total health so you can avoid the execute range of Draven R Whirling Death. Basic attacks and attack speed drive his damage, so reducing attack speed is also effective.
Draven.fight: Do not fight while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe axes. Once he is down to one or fewer and Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, take a short trade and retreat out of range.
Draven.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave and look for a CS and Turret Plating lead. After pushing, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks. If Draven maintains two Draven Q Spinning Axe axes and you cannot trade, farm safely and do not give up a kill.
Draven.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Draven's axe will land or where he will retreat. If he steps on a trap, hit him with an empowered attack from the extended range of Caitlyn P Headshot, then land Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Draven.escape: Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so look to close the gap after Draven E Stand Aside is used and he has fewer axes.
Draven.phase: Caitlyn has strong range and lane pressure early, but avoid trading with Draven while he maintains two axes. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives, and look to catch Draven with your team when he is alone. In late game, use Caitlyn's range advantage to attack safely instead of relying on raw sustained damage.
Draven.teamfight: Attack from the edge of your maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. Another enemy can take Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole instead, so do not use it during a chaotic fight.

Ezreal.watch: Move within the wave so minions block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, step out of range briefly because his next attack will deal bonus damage. When your health is low, retreat along terrain while avoiding the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. Force Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then close the gap. If you keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, Ezreal E Arcane Shift may come back sooner, so attack quickly.
Ezreal.laning: Push the wave first to keep Ezreal under his turret and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. Keep minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance ahead of time.
Ezreal.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Ezreal will retreat. If it catches him, follow an empowered attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Ezreal.escape: Go in immediately after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is used.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, use Caitlyn's long range to control the lane and pressure Ezreal's CS and Turret Plating. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives. In late game, use your range advantage to attack from a safe position instead of trying to win through raw damage.
Ezreal.teamfight: Attack from Caitlyn's maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself.

Jhin.watch: Jhin's last bullet deals heavy damage, so back off while he has it. Right after Jhin hits you with a basic attack or you step on Jhin E Captive Audience, move out of the line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish to avoid the root. Be especially careful of Jhin R Curtain Call when low on health, and stay away from low-health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade cannot bounce to you.
Jhin.build: Build armor first against Jhin's main damage. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience, and attack speed reduction has little value because Jhin's attack speed is fixed.
Jhin.fight: Count Jhin's bullets and trade while he reloads or after he has fired one or two shots. When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, attack and then move out of range.
Jhin.laning: Use your early range advantage to push the wave first, keep Jhin under his turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. Once the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks. Stand apart from the wave so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade cannot kill a low-health minion and bounce to you.
Jhin.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Jhin will retreat. If it catches him, follow a Caitlyn P Headshot empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move in while he reloads.
Jhin.phase: Early on, pressure Jhin with Caitlyn's long range to gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lane lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, use your range advantage to attack from a safe position instead of stepping forward and relying only on sustained damage.
Jhin.teamfight: Attack from Caitlyn's maximum range, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. If you are low on health, focus on dodging Jhin R Curtain Call. Do not use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole in a chaotic fight where another enemy could take the shot.

Jinx.watch: Do not stand beside minions when Jinx attacks them with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets. Avoid the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! When your health is low, get out of finishing range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! Do not start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.build: Build armor first against Jinx's main damage. Basic attacks and attack speed drive her damage, so attack speed reduction is also useful, but your priority is to avoid staying within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! while low on health.
Jinx.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. Look for a chance to attack while Jinx pokes with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets, since she will not have minigun attack speed stacks.
Jinx.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Jinx under her turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. Do not stand alongside minions where the area damage from Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets can hit you too. Once the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance.
Jinx.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Jinx will retreat. If it catches her, follow the increased-range Caitlyn P Headshot empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Jinx.escape: Move in when Jinx E Flame Chompers! has missed or already been used and the slow from Jinx W Zap! has also missed.
Jinx.phase: Early game is when Caitlyn's range and lane pressure are strong, so build a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, use your range advantage to attack from a safe position instead of drawing out sustained damage fights.
Jinx.teamfight: Position at the edge of your maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. Do not use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole in a chaotic fight, since another enemy could take the shot.

Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, it leaves a mark that lets her engage with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. When Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread out its missiles. If Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks build up on you, wait out of range for them to expire.
Kaisa.build: Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker deal magic damage, so armor alone will not protect you. If you cannot quickly kill her through the shield from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, build magic resistance and health as well.
Kaisa.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately.
Kaisa.laning: While Kai'Sa is pinned under her turret, look for Turret Plating and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance in advance. When playing around Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, do not move away from the wave on your own.
Kaisa.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Kai'Sa will retreat. If it catches her, follow the increased-range empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Kaisa.phase: In mid game, turn the CS and Turret Plating lead from lane into turrets and objectives to make use of Caitlyn's strength. Late game, sustained damage fights may become unfavorable, so attack safely from maximum range.
Kaisa.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along Kai'Sa's approach paths and around yourself. Before a fight, place Control Wards in side bushes and approach paths to prepare for Kai'Sa appearing from the flank with Kai'Sa E Supercharge.

Kalista.watch: Kalista P Martial Poise lets her hop closer, so watch her basic attack windup to predict where she will move next. Kalista E Rend deals the damage from all spears lodged in you at once; if several have hit you, stop fighting and retreat until they disappear. If her support moves close to Kalista before Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out and prepare Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the landing spot.
Kalista.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building a large amount of health alone.
Kalista.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage to trade once, then back off immediately. Aim Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker as Kalista starts a basic attack rather than firing it after you see her hop with Kalista P Martial Poise.
Kalista.laning: Early on, use Caitlyn's range advantage to push the wave first, keep Kalista under her turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. Charge Caitlyn P Headshot in a bush and use it on a champion. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance. If several of Kalista's spears are lodged in you, stop pressuring and retreat safely.
Kalista.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Kalista will retreat or where you expect her to hop next. If it catches her, land a Caitlyn P Headshot empowered basic attack from its increased range, then follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is down, there is less need to worry about her throwing her support in to engage. Use Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap to block Kalista's movement options and start a fight.
Kalista.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach paths and around yourself. Do not use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole during a chaotic fight, since another enemy could take the shot.

KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, he gains range and his basic attacks deal additional damage based on maximum health. Keep your distance until it ends. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with a minion or sidestep it. If it hits, avoid fighting while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. When low on health, watch for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and move out of vision to heal. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his body to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.build: The provided information does not establish a specific item purchase order. If building resistances, consider magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Also consider armor against his basic attacks. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage adds damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
KogMaw.fight: Poke when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, then back off immediately after the trade. Close the distance again once Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. If Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle hits you, stay away while your resistances are reduced.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, use Caitlyn's range advantage to push the wave first and keep Kog'Maw under his turret, pressuring his CS and Turret Plating. Prepare Caitlyn P Headshot and use it on him. Use Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker when Kog'Maw moves out from beside the minions or gets caught in a trap. While pushing, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks.
KogMaw.combo: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under his feet or where he will retreat. If it catches him, use the empowered basic attack from the extended range of Caitlyn P Headshot, then follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility ability to create distance on his own. Look to engage after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze.
KogMaw.phase: Early laning is Caitlyn's chance to pressure with her range, so build a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. Kog'Maw's sustained damage grows stronger over time, so late game, use Caitlyn's range advantage to attack from a safe position.
KogMaw.teamfight: Attack from the edge of your maximum range, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along Kog'Maw’s path and around yourself. Don’t force an approach while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active; look for a chance to trap Kog'Maw after it ends.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its indicated range, so avoid lining up behind a minion he is attacking. When Lucian uses Lucian R The Culling, sidestep instead of running straight back. If Lucian receives a shield or heal, or an ally becomes immobilized, back away to avoid his empowered two shots.
Lucian.build: Build armor first. Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling deal physical damage, but armor does not block the magic damage from Lucian W Ardent Blaze. The provided information does not establish a specific first item.
Lucian.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. Counterattack after Lucian's first combo has passed, especially right after he uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Lucian.laning: Early on, use Caitlyn's range advantage to push the wave first and keep Lucian under his turret, aiming for a CS and Turret Plating lead. While pushing, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance ahead of time to guard against ganks. Do not stand behind a minion Lucian is targeting with Lucian Q Piercing Light.
Lucian.combo: Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under his feet or where he will retreat. If it catches him, land an empowered basic attack from the extended range, then follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your chance to approach and catch him with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.
Lucian.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach routes and around yourself. Another enemy can intercept Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, so do not use it in a chaotic fight.

MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind minions, so do not line up with a minion. Leave the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain so you do not take Miss Fortune R Bullet Time while slowed. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time begins, move out through the side of its fixed cone or break line of sight.
MissFortune.build: Build armor first against Miss Fortune's main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately.
MissFortune.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first and keep Miss Fortune under her turret, aiming for a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance and stand beside minions to avoid Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Right after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to reduce her next basic attack poke.
MissFortune.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Miss Fortune will retreat. If it catches her, use an empowered basic attack from Caitlyn P Headshot, then Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, so engage when Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is unavailable and you can avoid its slow.
MissFortune.phase: Caitlyn has a strong early laning phase, so build a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, attack from a safe position using your range advantage rather than assuming which champion has more raw damage.
MissFortune.teamfight: Do not start a fight inside Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; move out of its area. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time begins, move out through the side of its cone or break line of sight.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through minions or allies to slow and heal, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. There is a delay between Senna W Last Embrace hitting and its root, so dodge it from behind minions. If you are marked, immediately move away from your allies. If Senna hits you once, back off to deny a second attack and prevent her from collecting Mist.
Senna.build: Senna's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Build health alongside armor rather than stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, add Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Senna.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, trade at the edge of your range, then back off immediately.
Senna.laning: Push the wave from the start to pin Senna under her turret and pressure for CS and Turret Plating. Watch where souls appear, and when Senna steps forward, harass her with Caitlyn P Headshot to disrupt her collection. Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap in advance along the river entrance.
Senna.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under Senna's feet or where she will retreat. If it catches her, use an empowered basic attack from Caitlyn P Headshot, then Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Use Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker when Senna moves out from beside the minions or gets caught in a trap.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace is unavailable, engage if Senna is in a position where she cannot create distance.
Senna.phase: Early on, pressure Senna with Caitlyn's long range and prevent her from collecting souls. In mid game, turn your laning lead into turrets and objectives. Senna's range and attack damage grow late game, so use Caitlyn's range advantage to deal damage from a safe position.
Senna.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach routes and around yourself. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off and move somewhere with vision, or attack the mist's area with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you are slowed, move out of the line directly in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore extends its range each time it hits an allied champion, so spread out sideways from your teammates in teamfights. When low on health, also watch for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on your missing health.
Seraphine.build: Complete one core item first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, buy Executioner's Calling afterward. If you need resistance against damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Seraphine Q High Note, and Seraphine E Beat Drop, choose magic resistance.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, then back out of range. Look to attack when Seraphine is separated from her allied marksman or has just used Seraphine E Beat Drop.
Seraphine.laning: Use Caitlyn's range advantage to push the wave first, keep Seraphine under her turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks. If Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use it to harass Seraphine instead of hitting a minion.
Seraphine.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Seraphine will retreat. If she steps on it, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility ability, so place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where she will retreat to block her escape. If you are slowed, prioritize moving out of the line over engaging.
Seraphine.phase: Early game is a good time for Caitlyn to use her range to pressure Seraphine and gain CS and Turret Plating leads. In mid game, turn those leads into turrets and objectives. In late game, use your range advantage to deal damage from a safe position.
Seraphine.teamfight: Attack from the edge of your maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on enemy approach paths and around yourself. Another enemy can intercept Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, so do not use it during a chaotic fight.

Samira.watch: Avoid giving Samira an opening to engage: if she closes in with Samira E Wild Rush, she can deal heavy damage at close range. Do not use basic attacks or projectile abilities while Samira W Blade Whirl is active; attack after it ends. If you are immobilized by an enemy, Samira can dash in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge the enemy's engage ability first.
Samira.build: Most of Samira's damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor will not block the magic damage from Samira P Daredevil Impulse or Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, take a short trade at the edge of your range and retreat immediately. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one has died, you have an opening to attack.
Samira.laning: Use your early range advantage to push the wave first, keep Samira under her turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. Harass with Caitlyn P Headshot when it is ready without giving Samira an angle to walk in. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance.
Samira.combo: After Samira E Wild Rush is down, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under her feet or where she will retreat. If she steps on it, land the empowered Caitlyn P Headshot basic attack from its extended range, then follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. If Samira W Blade Whirl is active, wait for it to end before using the basic attack or Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Samira.escape: The moment Samira E Wild Rush is down is your opening to engage.
Samira.phase: Early laning is Caitlyn's window to pressure Samira with her range advantage. In mid game, turn your laning lead into turrets and objectives. In late game, attack from a safe position using your range advantage rather than relying on sustained damage alone.
Samira.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on enemy approach paths and around yourself. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with the root from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.

Sivir.watch: Watch the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and dodge both the outgoing and returning hits. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid long chases.
Sivir.build: If the enemy team has a lot of healing, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Most damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet is physical, so build armor first when you need resistance.
Sivir.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage to trade damage, then retreat immediately.
Sivir.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Sivir under her turret, and look for a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the wave before leaving lane or have an ally ready to catch it.
Sivir.combo: When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under her feet or where she will retreat. If she steps on it, land the empowered basic attack and follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no ability to create distance herself, so close the gap and use Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap to block her escape. If the enemy can engage, save Caitlyn E 90 Caliber Net, your only escape ability.
Sivir.phase: Caitlyn's range and lane pressure are strong early, so build a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, focus on turning that lead into turrets and objectives. In late game, use Caitlyn's range advantage to deal damage from a safe position.
Sivir.teamfight: Attack from the edge of Caitlyn's maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on enemy approach paths and around yourself. Even if Sivir E Spell Shield is down and you have an opening to catch Sivir, take only short fights around terrain and vision while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! slows and grants growth stacks when it hits a champion, so stand behind minions or move sideways to dodge it. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, move away from its center and do not follow Smolder into the flames that heal him. As Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath scales, it gains true damage and an execute, so be especially careful when low on health.
Smolder.build: Build armor first against Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!, his main damage source. Keep enough health to stay above the execute threshold of a scaled Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, but do not stack only health because it also deals damage based on maximum health. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Smolder.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade and retreat immediately.
Smolder.laning: Pressure Smolder with your range before Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks up, limiting his CS and chances to kill enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Push the wave first to keep Smolder under his turret and look for Turret Plating. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance to guard against ganks.
Smolder.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Smolder will retreat. If he steps on it, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker deals reduced damage to Smolder behind minions, so fire it when he steps on the trap or moves clear of the minions.
Smolder.escape: Your opening to engage is right after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down and you have dodged Smolder W Achooo!.
Smolder.phase: Caitlyn can apply her strongest pressure with her range advantage early, when Smolder is weak because he has no growth stacks yet. In mid game, turn your laning lead into turrets and objectives. As the game goes late, Smolder P Dragon Practice's permanent stacks make the matchup less favorable, so deal damage from a safe range.
Smolder.teamfight: Attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on enemy approach paths and around yourself. Another enemy can intercept Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, so do not use it during a chaotic fight.

Tristana.watch: Tristana R Buster Shot also forces movement, so do not commit recklessly while both abilities are ready. Near allied minions, watch for the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Tristana.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. Tristana W Rocket Jump being down gives you a chance to close the gap, but do not force an engage if Tristana R Buster Shot is still available.
Tristana.laning: Early on, push the wave first to keep Tristana under her turret and pressure her CS and Turret Plating. Stand away from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Once the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach.
Tristana.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Tristana will retreat. If it catches her, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Tristana.escape: Right after you make Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to engage. Watch for the forced movement from Tristana R Buster Shot, and have Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap ready when you go in.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early, so use Caitlyn's range to pressure the lane and turret. In mid game, turn your laning lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, Tristana's damage becomes threatening, so fight from a safe distance.
Tristana.teamfight: Attack at the edge of your maximum range, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along Tristana W Rocket Jump's approach and around yourself. If an ally falls and Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, retreat immediately.

Twitch.watch: Use a Control Ward to reveal Twitch Q Ambush's approach, and check unwarded brush before passing through. If Twitch W Venom Cask hits you, leave it immediately. If you have taken several basic attacks, make space and watch for Twitch E Contaminate even if you still have health left.
Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward first to reveal Twitch Q Ambush's approach. One type of resistance alone is hard to rely on against Twitch E Contaminate, and resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, so also consider your total health and how many basic attacks you take.
Twitch.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately.
Twitch.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Twitch under his turret, and gain CS and Turret Plating. Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach and at brush entrances in advance, and alert your allies when Twitch disappears from lane.
Twitch.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Twitch will retreat. If it catches him, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Twitch.escape: Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, then look to engage once Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is revealed.
Twitch.phase: Early game is your chance to use Caitlyn's range and lane pressure to gain CS and Turret Plating. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, deal damage from a safe distance instead of matching raw damage, and watch for the increased range of Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, avoid lining up with your allies and spread out sideways. The moment Twitch Q Ambush ends and he appears, focus him with your allies.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his range.
TwistedFate.build: The provided information is not enough to determine your first purchase. Build magic resistance over armor against the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and Twisted Fate E Stacked Deck.
TwistedFate.fight: Only trade using your range advantage when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, then back off immediately.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Twisted Fate under his turret, and build a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach in advance, and stand behind minions when watching for Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Twisted Fate will retreat. If it catches him, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
TwistedFate.escape: Your window to engage is after Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and Twisted Fate R Destiny is down.
TwistedFate.phase: Early game is when Caitlyn can use her range to pressure the lane and turret. Late game, Caitlyn uses her range advantage to attack from a safe position.
TwistedFate.teamfight: If you can predict where Twisted Fate R Destiny will land, prepare vision and traps there in advance. Another enemy can intercept Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, so do not use it during a chaotic fight.

Varus.watch: Once blight has stacked from Varus W Blighted Quiver, getting hit by an ability deals additional damage based on your maximum health. If you have taken a few basic attacks, retreat to give the stacks time to expire. Varus R Chain of Corruption can also spread from the first ally it hits, so keep your distance from a rooted ally. When you see Varus aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, step sideways out of the arrow's path.
Varus.build: The provided information is not enough to determine exactly what to buy first. Build armor first to resist the main damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Given the maximum-health-based damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver, avoid responding by stacking health alone.
Varus.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage to trade, then back off immediately. When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge sideways to create an opportunity to punish him while he slows himself.
Varus.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Varus under his turret, and pressure his CS and Turret Plating. Harass Varus only when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready. Use Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker when Varus moves away from the minions or gets caught in a trap. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach.
Varus.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Varus will retreat. If it catches him, follow the increased-range empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to close the gap after Varus R Chain of Corruption is down.
Varus.phase: Early game is your chance to use Caitlyn's long range to pressure Varus's CS and Turret Plating. In mid game, turn your laning lead into turrets and objectives. The provided information is not enough to say which champion is stronger late game; Caitlyn should use her range advantage to deal damage from a safe position.
Varus.teamfight: Caitlyn should attack at the edge of her maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along the enemy's approach and around herself. Avoid fighting for the few seconds Varus is stronger after getting a kill or assist. Use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole only when no other enemy can intercept it.

Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if at least three returning feathers hit.
Xayah.build: Build armor first, since Xayah P Clean Cuts, Xayah Q Double Daggers, and Xayah W Deadly Plumage deal primarily physical damage.
Xayah.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, take a short trade, then immediately retreat out of range.
Xayah.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Xayah under her turret, and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance, and reposition after each trade so Xayah's feathers do not build up.
Xayah.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Xayah will retreat. If it catches her, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Xayah.phase: Early on, Caitlyn can pressure Xayah with her range advantage. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, attack safely from long range instead of relying on raw damage.
Xayah.teamfight: Attack from maximum range, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach routes and around yourself.

Vayne.watch: Do not fight with your back to a wall, where Vayne E Condemn can stun you. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health after enough attacks on the same target, so count the hits you take and leave her range before it triggers.
Vayne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, which also scales with maximum health, so avoid simply stacking health. Since Vayne's basic attacks and attack speed drive her damage, also consider a defensive item that reduces attack speed.
Vayne.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then retreat immediately.
Vayne.laning: Use your range advantage from the start to push the wave first, disrupt Vayne’s farming, and pressure Turret Plating. Prepare Caitlyn P Headshot to hit the champion, and after trading, don’t give Vayne Q Tumble an opening to close the gap. While the lane is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river entrance to guard against ganks.
Vayne.combo: Then place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Vayne will retreat. If it catches her, follow up with the empowered basic attack from Caitlyn P Headshot and Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Immediately after she is trapped, Caitlyn P Headshot gains greatly increased range, and Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker deals unreduced damage.
Vayne.escape: Right after you force Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the distance.
Vayne.phase: Early game is Caitlyn's chance to use her range advantage to pressure Vayne's low health and armor. In mid game, turn your CS and Turret Plating lead into turrets and objectives. Vayne's sustained damage grows stronger late game, so Caitlyn should use her range advantage to attack from a safe position.
Vayne.teamfight: Caitlyn should attack from maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along Vayne's approach routes and around herself. During Vayne R Final Hour, look for the moment her invisibility ends. Do not use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole if another enemy is in its path or during a chaotic fight.

Ziggs.watch: Stepping on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes his other abilities easier to land, so take a route without mines or wait for them to disappear. If you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center of the blast even if you cannot leave the area entirely.
Ziggs.build: The source material specifies no particular item to buy first, so it does not establish a purchase order. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ziggs's main damage, and consider movement speed to help leave telegraphed attack areas.
Ziggs.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage to start a trade, then retreat after attacking.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, use your range advantage to push the wave first, keep Ziggs under his turret, and pressure his CS and Turret Plating. After pushing, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance in advance, and do not enter a route blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Since Ziggs W Satchel Charge can destroy a turret, do not leave a wave unattended in front of a low-health allied turret.
Ziggs.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Ziggs will retreat. If it catches him, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Ziggs.escape: Right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave is your opening to engage.
Ziggs.phase: Early game is Caitlyn's chance to use her range to gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, attack safely at the edge of your range instead of relying on an advantage in raw sustained damage.
Ziggs.teamfight: Caitlyn should position at maximum range and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach routes and around herself. Do not cluster together against Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, and do not use Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole in a chaotic fight where another enemy could take the hit.

Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads across a wide area when it hits terrain, so do not stand with your back to a wall or face her in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so do not push her toward one. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, her movement speed increases, so do not chase her on foot.
Zeri.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge, while Zeri R Lightning Crash deals both damage types. Zeri P Living Battery also deals damage based on maximum health and can execute, so be wary of simply stacking health.
Zeri.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then retreat immediately.
Zeri.laning: Early on, pressure short-ranged Zeri to build a CS lead, and push the wave first to pursue Turret Plating. If you charged Caitlyn P Headshot in the lane brush, use it on Zeri rather than a minion. Once you push the lane, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap at the river entrance in advance to guard against ganks.
Zeri.combo: Then place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Zeri will retreat. If it catches her, follow the empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker deals reduced damage to targets behind minions, so aim it when Zeri has moved beside the minions or is trapped.
Zeri.escape: Right after Zeri E Spark Surge is used is your opening to engage.
Zeri.phase: Early on, use Caitlyn's range advantage to pressure Zeri and gain a CS and Turret Plating lead. In mid game, turn that lead into turrets and objectives, and widen the gap before Zeri completes her core items. Late game, watch out for Zeri's mobility and sustained damage, and have Caitlyn attack safely at the edge of her range.
Zeri.teamfight: Caitlyn should position at maximum range first, then place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap along enemy approach routes and around herself.

Nilah.watch: Step back an extra pace immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, as it increases her attack range. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, use ability damage instead of basic attacks, or wait for the effect to end.
Nilah.build: Complete one core item first. If Nilah and the opposing team have a lot of healing, fit in Executioner's Calling. If you need defenses, build armor first to match Nilah's main damage. Because Nilah Q Formless Blade has penetration, build health too instead of relying on armor alone.
Nilah.fight: When Caitlyn P Headshot is ready, use your range advantage for a short trade, then back off immediately. After Nilah engages and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, look for a chance to catch her with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.
Nilah.laning: Push the wave first to keep Nilah at her turret and pressure Turret Plating. While the wave is pushed, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach to prepare for a gank.
Nilah.combo: Place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap where Nilah will engage or retreat. If she is caught, follow a Caitlyn P Headshot empowered basic attack with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker. Do not rush the empowered basic attack while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active.
Nilah.escape: Once Nilah has used Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil, catch her with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap and attack. If Nilah R Apotheosis is still available, do not group up close to her.
Nilah.phase: Early on, Caitlyn can pressure Nilah hard with her range advantage. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives. The given information does not establish which champion has the advantage late, so deal damage from a safe distance as Caitlyn.
Nilah.teamfight: Attack from maximum range, and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on Nilah's approach and around yourself. After Nilah engages and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, look for a chance to catch her with a trap.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, it can knock you up with a tornado. When you see its stack effect, move out of its line and dodge sideways. Yasuo can use minions to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so keep your distance when the wave gives him plenty of targets to dash through. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, change your angle or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. An attack speed slow delays Yasuo's basic attacks and how often his tornado becomes available.
Yasuo.fight: Strip Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer shield with light poke first, then trade when Caitlyn P Headshot is ready. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so attack from your range advantage and back off immediately.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, use Caitlyn's long range to pressure Yasuo's CS and Turret Plating. However, Yasuo can use minions to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When you need to prevent his approach, manage the wave so a small enemy wave pushes toward your side. If you push the lane, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on the river approach in advance.
Yasuo.combo: After Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears, place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap under Yasuo or where he will retreat. If he is caught, land a Caitlyn P Headshot empowered basic attack from the increased range, then follow with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Yasuo.escape: If Yasuo has thrown his tornado, briefly leaving him without a way to knock you up, and Yasuo R Last Breath has not come back up, look for an opportunity to engage with crowd control. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so do not chase deep just because he used one dash.
Yasuo.phase: Early game is a good time for Caitlyn to pressure the lane and turret with her range. In mid game, turn your lane lead into turrets and objectives. Late game, Caitlyn's sustained damage is relatively weaker, so use her range advantage to attack from a safe position.
Yasuo.teamfight: Position at maximum range as Caitlyn and place Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap on Yasuo's approach and around yourself. Avoid using Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole in a chaotic fight: another enemy can take the hit, and Caitlyn cannot move while casting it.
